description.value: Established in 1996, Pearl Castle Cafe is a Richmond institution credited with introducing freshly-made Taiwanese pearl tea to the city, later expanding to a full café concept in 1997. It has earned four consecutive Chinese Restaurant Awards for Best Taiwanese Café and offers a broad menu spanning bubble teas, hotpot, noodles, fried rice, and Taiwanese street food. The cafe is situated inside the Continental Centre shopping mall, making it a sheltered stop for cyclists navigating Richmond's commercial corridors.
